143 I Miss You
programme.desc: Carefree Siddu elopes with Sanjana, a beloved sister to four brothers. Their union is tragically cut short when Naxalites capture Sanjana, leaving Siddu to believe she's dead.

programme.title: Jaya Janaki Nayaka
programme.desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

programme.title: Kshana Kshanam
programme.desc: Satya and Chandu embark on a long haul, but their journey takes an unexpected turn when they are pursued by a quirky burglar who robs banks.

programme.title: The Raja Saab
programme.desc: RajaSaab's search for his estranged grandfather leads him to a haunted mansion. He learns that his grandfather Kanakaraju, an exorcist, has laid a trap to lure him.

programme.title: Yevadu
programme.desc: Satya gets a different face after he is almost killed, but a new face multiplies his problems. His ordeal begins when he leaves the hospital and has to deal with his lover's murderer.

programme.title: Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai
programme.desc: Dr. Abhimanyu, a misogynist, falls for Akshara, their daughter. Complications arise when Akshara's half-sister, Arohi, also falls for him.

programme.title: Anupamaa
programme.desc: Anupamaa sacrifices her ambitions for family, feeling uncredited. She finds empowerment by living on her terms after trials, showcasing a dramatic journey of resilience and independence.

programme.desc: Liam, seorang penulis yang tidak berpuas hati dengan kehidupannya sebagai suami dan bapa. Suatu hari, dia menemui sebuah mesin taip ajaib yang membolehkannya menulis semula hidupnya dan memasuki dunia alternatif. Di dunia baharu itu, Liam dan isterinya Joyce menjalani kehidupan sangat berbeza daripada realiti asal. Namun, perubahan ini memaksa Liam memilih antara mengejar impian atau mempertahanka

programme.title: Past Life, Present Love
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dua insan yang terikat oleh cinta dari kehidupan lampau. Walaupun dilahirkan semula dalam kehidupan masa kini, tanpa ingatan silam, mereka membangkitkan perasaan yang sukar dijelaskan. Cinta yang kembali berputik diuji oleh takdir dan rahsia masa lalu. Lakonan : Tack Parunyu Rojanawuttitum, Film Thanapat Kawala, Pechaya Wattanamontri, Sinjai Plengpanich dan ramai lagi.

programme.title: Mithra

Ini kerana Jayakumar terlibat dalam penculikan tersebut. Ini kerana Jayakumar tidak berada di rumah mahupun bengkel keretanya. Lakonan : Ben G, Ratna Gowri, Arunkumaran, Gunasegaran dan Evarani.

Dia dituduh tidak siuman lalu dimasukkan ke pusat psikiatri.

programme.desc: ”Express” është emisioni televiziv me historinë më të gjatë në transmetim ndër televizionet kosovare. Në sezonin e shtatëmbëdhjetë vazhdon të jetë emisioni i pasdites për kosovarët. programme.title: Lajmet e mbrëmjes
programme.desc: Lajmet e Mbrëmjes, çdo mbrëmje nga ora 19:00, janë edicioni kryesor dhe më i besueshëm i lajmeve në Kosovë. Një grup gazetarësh e redaktorësh sjellin të gjitha lajmet nga politika deri te kultura, nga secili skaj i Kosovës. programme.desc: Wójt ma problem. Zbliżają się urodziny wojewody, a on nie wie, co kupić, by przypodobać się władzy. Nieoczekiwanie świetny pomysł podsuwa mu nowy znajomy Klaudii, psycholog behawiorysta.

programme.title: Młodzież kontra, czyli pod ostrzałem
programme.desc: Widowisko publicystyczne z udziałem młodzieży partyjnej, która zadaje pytania zaproszonemu gościowi tj. znaczącemu politykowi lub ważnej osobie życia publicznego. Moderatorem i gospodarzem programu jest osoba prowadząca. Gość: Łukasz Kmita, poseł, Rozwój Plus.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Rodzinny wieczór filmowy przeradza się w chaos - każdy forsuje swój wybór filmu i jedzenia. Ostatecznie wszyscy zasypiają przy przypadkowym dokumencie o pingwinach.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Rodzina Pyrków w dalszym ciągu jest zmuszona tolerować w domu Adasia - bezdomnego narkomana, którego sprowadzili Wilkowie. Joasia mierzy się z poważnym problemem - znalezienie dla Emila korepetytora z matematyki graniczy z cudem.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. W programie wykorzystano współcześnie realizowane zdjęcia, jak również bogate i różnorodne materiały archiwalne.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Zbliża się lato 1939 r. Komunikaty radiowe nie pozostawiają złudzeń - Hitler grozi Europie wojną. Z obawy o swą przyszłość brwinowscy Żydzi emigrują do Ameryki, Guido zabiera Andzię z dziećmi do Włoch. O wyjeździe myślą też Wieruszowie.

programme.title: Ojciec Mateusz
programme.desc: W okolicach kościoła Natalia znajduje martwego mężczyznę. Okazuje się, że zmarł z wycieńczenia. W mieście niedawno została zamknięta noclegownia. W parku znaleziono kolejnego martwego mężczyznę. Sekcja wskazuje na zatrucie alkaloidem. Trop prowadzi do kościoła. Okazuje się, że ktoś chciał otruć księdza Mateusza.

programme.title: Fenomen Fogga
programme.desc: Film ukazujący sylwetkę Mieczysława Fogga, największej gwiazdy piosenki okresu międzywojennego, jednej z najważniejszych postaci kultury popularnej czasów PRL - u. Artysty, który przez dekady komunizmu był symbolem II Rzeczpospolitej.

programme.title: Pan Mama
programme.desc: Sylwester obsesyjnie udowadnia, że wciąż jest młody i chce kupić od Mirasa motocykl. Za to Zuza chce zrobić sobie tatuaż, Bruno nadążyć za starszymi, a Patrycja testuje relację z Romanem.

programme.title: Polacy światu
programme.desc: Antoni Cierplikowski ps. Antoine - polski stylista o międzynarodowej sławie, twórca nowoczesnego fryzjerstwa, producent kosmetyków. Przeszedł do historii mody jako autor fryzury "na chłopczycę" dla Coco Chanel.

programme.title: Polacy na ratunek Żydom
programme.desc: Państwo Karolina i Włodzimierz Skrzyńscy mieszkali z dwiema córkami przy ulicy Szczebrzeskiej 48 w Zamościu. Wiosną 1942 roku 9 - letniemu Mosze Frankowi udało się uciec z transportu, którym Niemcy wysłali do obozu przejściowego w Izbicy.

programme.title: Wojenne dziewczyny
programme.desc: Marysię przesłuchują na Szucha. Nie chce wyjawić prawdziwego nazwiska. Niemiec katuje ją, a potem druzgocze je dłoń przyciskiem do papieru. Pobita Marysia trafia do celi na Pawiaku. Ranna Irka przebywa w domu Grudzińskiego na folwarku.

programme.title: Dom
programme.desc: Ewa rodzi drugiego syna. Leszek studiuje weterynarię. Spokojne życie braci Talarów zakłóca wiadomość o śmierci ojca. Andrzej sprzedaje gospodarstwo i zabiera matkę do siebie. Ewa usiłuje prowadzić wielkomiejskie życie: urządza imieniny Andrzeja, podczas których znika jego matka, jak się okazuje - wyproszona z domu przez synową. Poszukiwania matki Andrzeja nie dają rezultatu.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. W programie wykorzystano współcześnie realizowane zdjęcia, jak również bogate i różnorodne materiały archiwalne.

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Rodzina Pyrków w dalszym ciągu jest zmuszona tolerować w domu Adasia - bezdomnego narkomana, którego sprowadzili Wilkowie. Joasia mierzy się z poważnym problemem - znalezienie dla Emila korepetytora z matematyki graniczy z cudem.

programme.title: Przyrodnik na tropie
programme.desc: Serial przyrodniczy, w którym prowadzący dr Łukasz Bożycki, porusza różne aspekty życia zwierząt w kontekście ich wzajemnych powiązań i oddziaływań. W tym odcinku przyjrzymy się kowalikowi.

programme.title: Okrasa łamie przepisy
programme.desc: W swojej kolejnej wyprawie kulinarnej Karol Okrasa zaprasza widzów na opowieść o wiśniach na słono. Pierwszą propozycją Karola jest smażony pstrąg tęczowy z wiśniami i prażoną dynią. Druga to wiśniowe pierogi leniwe w wiśniowej glazurze.

programme.title: Polacy na ratunek Żydom
programme.desc: Państwo Karolina i Włodzimierz Skrzyńscy mieszkali z dwiema córkami przy ulicy Szczebrzeskiej 48 w Zamościu. Wiosną 1942 roku 9 - letniemu Mosze Frankowi udało się uciec z transportu, którym Niemcy wysłali do obozu przejściowego w Izbicy.

programme.title: Stulecie Winnych
programme.desc: Zbliża się lato 1939 r. Komunikaty radiowe nie pozostawiają złudzeń - Hitler grozi Europie wojną. Z obawy o swą przyszłość brwinowscy Żydzi emigrują do Ameryki, Guido zabiera Andzię z dziećmi do Włoch. O wyjeździe myślą też Wieruszowie.

programme.title: Stawka większa niż życie
programme.desc: Rok 1944. Kloss jedzie do Saint Gilles, aby zorganizować odbicie aresztowanego Bogdana. Podróż się przedłuża, jego pociąg zostaje zbombardowany. W Normandii czeka na Klossa francuski partyzant Hubert Ornell...

programme.title: Vito odkrywa Polskę
programme.desc: Vito Raho to urodzony w Apulii fotograf, podróżnik i przewodnik turystyczny. Przez całe życie odwiedził kilkadziesiąt państw, z czego w kilkunastu mieszkał na stałe. Teraz chce sprawdzić, czy byłby w stanie zostać na dłużej w Polsce.

programme.title: Przez pamięć i zapomnienie
programme.desc: Podróż przez polskie miasta i miasteczka - niegdyś tętniące życiem ośrodki społeczności żydowskiej - inspirowana książką Mordechaja Canina "Wśród ruin i popiołów".

programme.title: Barwy szczęścia
programme.desc: Błażej usiłuje łączyć opiekę nad matką w Szczecinie z zarządzaniem redakcją w trybie zdalnym, co prowadzi do narastających konfliktów i trudności organizacyjnych. Tymczasem uwagę Weroniki przyciąga nowy temat dziennikarski.

programme.title: W światłach zorzy
programme.desc: Na dalekiej północy, w Laponii, czas płynie inaczej. Surowe warunki, które zmuszają mieszkańców do korzystania z psich zaprzęgów, wydają się Monice i Maćkowi spełnieniem ich marzeń. Film przedstawia kilka dni z życia polskiej rodziny, która w 2017 roku zdecydowała się zamieszkać w jednym z najzimniejszych miejsc na Ziemi.

programme.title: Niezwykłe miejsca
programme.desc: Krótkie reportaże o charakterze edukacyjnym prezentujące niezwykłe miejsca w Polsce. W programie wykorzystano współcześnie realizowane zdjęcia, jak również bogate i różnorodne materiały archiwalne.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Dalszy ciąg historii życia i miłości 3 pokoleń kobiet: Barbary, jej córki Gosi i wnuczki Marysi. Akcja również toczy się na Mazurach. Nad rozlewiskiem skończył się sezon letni, nastała jesień. Marysia próbuje sił w pisaniu pamiętnika.

programme.title: Cisza nad rozlewiskiem
programme.desc: Krzysztof dostaje propozycję awansu, związaną z wyjazdem do Szczytna. Marysia ma wątpliwości, co do dalszego życia u boku Krzysztofa - wciąż myśli o dziecku. Kuba szuka nowego lokum. Teraz muszą z Agatą zamieszkać u jego rodziców.

programme.title: Rozmowy (nie)wygodne
programme.desc: Inspirujące rozmowy Mariusza Szczygła z wybitnymi osobowościami świata kultury i sztuki. Prowokujące pytania, wymagające nieszablonowych odpowiedzi i odkrywania swojej osobowości. Wywiady odbywać się będą we "Wrzenie Świata" - miejscu spotkań bohemy intelektualnej Warszawy. Gość: Krystyna Kurczab - Redlich, dziennikarka, reportażystka, wieloletnia korespondentka w Rosji.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gordon wants to show Fred & Gino that the food and fresh produce are off the charts! In Las Vegas they indulge in one of the most expensive beef burgers. After a night at the casino they're on the road again to experience the real wild west.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Road Trip
programme.desc: Gino & Fred are excited to head to San Francisco for their very own Summer of Love. Gordon tries to embrace the flower power mood, but he's more interested in the 61 Michelin Stars. The boys travel to a Napa Valley vineyard in a hot air balloon.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food journey in Bangkok where he searches for the best Tom Yum soup and entertains the locals with a rare Thai delicacy.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia
programme.desc: In Kuala Lumpur, Luke meets the famous Mr Hung with a reputation for flying instant noodles and Mr Sou who cooks a hearty Pork Bone Soup with medicinal herbal properties.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Street Food Asia
programme.desc: Luke continues his street food adventure exploring Jakarta, a melting pot of diverse cultural cuisines, where he indulges in an Indonesian dessert, the sweet Martabak, known as the "King of Street Food".

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke searches to find Ho Chi Minh's old markets before they disappear due to District 1's rapid development. Join Luke as he gathers fresh ingredients from a local market, tries some traditional delicacies, and follows his sweet tooth to Marou.

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke's next stop is the destination of Dalat. Follow Luke as he visits the Art Deco Dalat Train Station, experiences the French influence of the region with a father and son chef duo, and discovers why Dalat is known as the "Land of Eternal Spring"!

programme.title: Luke Nguyen's Railway Vietnam
programme.desc: Luke hops on the train in Ga Thap Cham, and finds himself in Nha Trang—a region of Vietnam with a similar vibe to the French Riviera! Luke hand-catches seafood, looks for some fresh durian fruit, and visits a barramundi farm to harvest sea grapes!

programme.desc: Populaire et très confiant, John F Kennedy devient le plus jeune président des Etats-Unis jamais élu ; il devra s'appuyer sur son frère Bob, nommé ministre de la Justice, pour gérer les désastres qui surviennent dès son début de mandat, en 1961.

programme.title: Sur les traces de l'Odyssée

Suivez les traces d'Ulysse dans un voyage à travers certains des paysages terrestres et marins les plus fascinants de la région méditerranéenne. Avec l'aide d'éminents spécialistes internationaux, résolvez les questions qui entourent encore l'une des plus grandes oeuvres littéraires de l'humanité et son auteur énigmatique.

programme.title: The Moving Beat
programme.desc: 'S1'. A new show that focuses on showcasing new talent of DJs.

programme.title: Bad Day at Black Rock
programme.desc: When John J. Macreedy (Spencer Tracy), a one-armed war veteran, arrives in the small desert town of Black Rock, he's not greeted warmly. Searching for a man named Komoko, Macreedy is met with disdain by virtually every local, including the resident thug, Hector David (Lee Marvin), and the imposing Reno Smith (Robert Ryan). As Macreedy's investigation deepens, hostility turns to violence -- and to imminent danger for the mysterious and inquisitive stranger.

programme.title: Edge of Doom
programme.desc: After the death of his ailing mother, Martin Lynn (Farley Granger) feels desperately alone. His only concern is that his mother receive an elegant burial. Unfortunately, Martin is also in a dire financial situation and cannot afford an expensive church service. Enraged, Martin viciously directs his frustrations at a clergyman, killing him. The impulsive act leaves Martin in an even more despondent state, though a kindly priest (Dana Andrews) may be able to guide the young man toward redemption.

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals.

programme.title: Seven Days in May
programme.desc: U.S. President Jordan Lyman (Fredric March) hopes to bring an end to the Cold War by signing a nuclear disarmament treaty with the Soviets, much to the displeasure of the hawkish General James Scott (Burt Lancaster), Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff. When Scott's aide, Martin "Jiggs" Casey (Kirk Douglas) stumbles on shattering evidence that the General is plotting a coup to overthrow Lyman in seven days, "Jiggs" alerts the President, setting off a dangerous race to thwart the takeover.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Swimmer
programme.desc: Well-off ad man Ned Merrill (Burt Lancaster) is visiting a friend when he notices the abundance of backyard pools that populate their upscale suburb. Ned suddenly decides that he'd like to travel the eight miles back to his own home by simply swimming across every pool in town. Soon, Ned's journey becomes harrowing; at each house, he is somehow confronted with a reminder of his romantic, domestic and economic failures, until a final visit with an old flame (Janice Rule) leaves him devastated.

programme.title: The Professionals
programme.desc: Four soldiers of fortune are hired by a wealthy rancher to rescue his beautiful young wife who has been kidnapped by a villainous Mexican bandit. When they finally find her, after fighting their way across deserts and mountains, they discover she is not being held against her will. This causes friction within the band as to whether they should honor their agreement.

programme.title: Birdman of Alcatraz
programme.desc: Sentenced to life in solitary confinement after killing a prison guard, despondent inmate Robert Stroud (Burt Lancaster) combats loneliness and tedium by nursing an ailing bird back to health. Stroud develops an interest in caring for birds and becomes a talented ornithologist. After publishing a book on bird diseases from jail, he meets and marries Stella (Betty Field), a fellow bird enthusiast. When Stroud is suddenly moved to Alcatraz, though, his marriage and work are both threatened.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Elmer Gantry
programme.desc: When hedonistic but charming con man Elmer Gantry (Burt Lancaster) meets the beautiful Sister Sharon Falconer (Jean Simmons), a roadside revivalist, he feigns piousness to join her act as a passionate preacher. The two make a successful onstage pair, and their chemistry extends to romance. Both the show and their relationship are threatened, however, when one of Gantry's ex-lovers (Shirley Jones) decides that she has a score to settle with the charismatic performer.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: With the Allies poised to retake Paris from the Germans, Col. Franz Von Waldheim (Paul Scofield) conspires to sneak out by train all the art masterpieces looted by the German army. But museum curator Mademoiselle Villard (Suzanne Flon) alerts the French Resistance, and soon railway inspector Paul Labiche (Burt Lancaster) is pressed into service. He reroutes the train, and cleverly deceives Von Waldheim by renaming each train station along the way.

programme.title: The Gypsy Moths
programme.desc: Three men who work in a skydiving performance group -- burned-out Mike (Burt Lancaster), outgoing showman Joe (Gene Hackman) and rookie Malcolm (Scott Wilson) -- find work in a small Kansas town and lodging at the home of Malcolm's Uncle John (William Windom) and Aunt Elizabeth (Deborah Kerr). The couple are in the midst of a marital crisis, and when Elizabeth meets the dashing Mike, everyone is surprised by their passionate and dangerous love affair.

programme.title: Princess O'Rourke
programme.desc: Princess Maria (Olivia de Havilland) and her uncle (Charles Coburn) are in Washington, D.C., where it is hoped she will meet a suitable man to marry. After a number of misfires on the romance front, Maria flies to San Francisco, sedating herself beforehand to combat her fear of flying. Still asleep when the plane sets down, Maria is taken in by the pilot, Eddie (Robert Cummings). When Maria wakes up and meets Edward, sparks fly -- but her royal lineage could complicate matters.

programme.title: Marie Antoinette
programme.desc: The young Austrian princess Marie Antoinette (Norma Shearer) is arranged to marry Louis XVI (Robert Morley), future king of France, in a politically advantageous marriage for the rival countries. The opulent Marie indulges in various whims and flirtations, including Count Axel (Tyrone Power). When Louis XV (John Barrymore) passes and Louis XVI ascends the French throne, his queen's extravagant lifestyle earns the hatred of the French people, who despise her Austrian heritage.

programme.title: The Swan
programme.desc: Prince Albert, who is scouring Europe for a wife, arrives in a tiny town to visit a banished family of nobles. Their matriarch, Beatrix, wants her daughter, Alexandra, to marry Albert so that her family will be welcomed back into the kingdom. In order to rouse Albert's attention, Alexandra flirts with her attractive tutor, Dr. Agi; however, Alexandra's plan hits a snag when she develops genuine feelings for Dr. Agi.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Her Highness and the Bellboy
programme.desc: A New York hotel bellboy (Robert Walker) forgets his girlfriend (June Allyson) after meeting a European princess (Hedy Lamarr).

programme.title: The Glass Slipper
programme.desc: In a retelling of the "Cinderella" tale, young orphan Ella (Leslie Caron) lives with her unpleasant stepmother (Elsa Lanchester) and stepsisters (Amanda Blake, Lisa Daniels), essentially working as their housekeeper. When the local prince (Michael Wilding) returns from school, a ball is announced. Around that time, Ella meets the prince, who is disguised as the son of the palace chef, and the two fall in love. When she manages to attend the ball, his revealed identity causes quite a stir.

programme.title: The Pirate
programme.desc: Manuela Alva is unhappily engaged to Don Pedro, the mayor of her town. When a circus arrives, she's enchanted by performer Serafin, who's likewise smitten with her. The mayor tries to evict the circus from town, but Serafin turns the tables after realizing Don Pedro is Macoco, an ex-pirate in hiding. When Serafin learns that Manuela dreams of Macoco, he adopts the discarded identity to woo her — but is then condemned to death for the pirate's crimes.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: This adventure-filled drama finds Englishman Rudolf Rassendyll (Ronald Colman) on vacation in a small European country, where he discovers his resemblance to the nation's royal heir-apparent, Rudolf V. When the king-to-be is drugged and incapacitated, Rassendyll must impersonate him, so that the scheming Duke Michael (Raymond Massey) can't assume the throne. To further complicate matters, Rassendyll starts to fall for Rudolf V's intended bride, Flavia (Madeleine Carroll).

programme.title: Edge of Eternity
programme.desc: Widowed Les Martin is an ex-detective haunted by a case he left behind in Denver. Now, Martin is the deputy sheriff of a small Arizona town with nothing to do but pull over beautiful local socialite Janice Kendon for occasional speeding -- until a mysterious murder at a nearby ghost town requires him to put his old skills to use once again. With the help of Sheriff Edwards and Kendon, Martin must unravel a murderous plot involving stolen gold.

programme.title: Easy Rider
programme.desc: Wyatt (Peter Fonda) and Billy (Dennis Hopper), two Harley-riding hippies, complete a drug deal in Southern California and decide to travel cross-country in search of spiritual truth. On their journey, they experience bigotry and hatred from the inhabitants of small-town America and also meet with other travelers seeking alternative lifestyles. After a terrifying drug experience in New Orleans, the two travelers wonder if they will ever find a way to live peacefully in America.

programme.title: The Grapes of Wrath
programme.desc: The Joad clan, introduced to the world in John Steinbeck's iconic novel, is looking for a better life in California. After their drought-ridden farm is seized by the bank, the family -- led by just-paroled son Tom -- loads up a truck and heads West. On the road, beset by hardships, the Joads meet dozens of other families making the same trek and holding onto the same dream. Once in California, however, the Joads soon realize that the promised land isn't quite what they hoped.

programme.title: Roadhouse 66
programme.desc: The villainous Hoot (Alan Autry), who patrols the desolate highways of the American Southwest with a gang of high-octane thugs, picks the wrong target: uptight and seemingly harmless Beckman Hallsgood Jr. (Judge Reinhold), who's on his way to California from New York on business. After Hoot and his men nearly force Beckman into an accident, Beckman gets some tips on payback from Johnny Harte (Willem Dafoe), a hitchhiking former musician who wants to take Hoot down and make the roads safe again.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: A disheveled man who wanders out of the desert, Travis Henderson (Harry Dean Stanton) seems to have no idea who he is. When a stranger manages to contact his brother, Walt (Dean Stockwell), Travis is awkwardly reunited with his sibling. Travis has been missing for years, and his presence unsettles Walt and his family, which also includes Travis's own son, Hunter (Hunter Carson). Soon Travis must confront his wife, Jane (Nastassja Kinski), and try to put his life back together.

programme.title: Three Daring Daughters
programme.desc: Convinced that their mother, Louise Morgan (Jeanette MacDonald), is lonely and unhappy, Tess (Jane Powell), Alix (Mary Eleanor Donahue) and Ilka (Ann E. Todd) plot to reunite her with their irresponsible father, Charlie, with the help of his rich employer, Robert Nelson (Edward Arnold). On a cruise, however, Louise meets bandleader Jose (Jose Iturbi), and the couple secretly marry. Back home, Louise wonders how to reveal her marriage when the girls tell her that Charlie is returning.

programme.title: Anchors Aweigh
programme.desc: Joe (Gene Kelly) and Clarence (Frank Sinatra) are two young Navy sailors on leave in glitzy Los Angeles. The two men at first plan to use their layover as an opportunity to relax, but they soon find themselves in a complicated web of comic secrets. When the two buddies find a runaway boy and return him to his fame-hungry Aunt Susan (Kathryn Grayson), both men find themselves falling for the wannabe singer, setting off a series of misadventures that unfold in comedy and song.

programme.title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
programme.desc: Despite being key players for the Wolves, baseball players Dennis Ryan (Frank Sinatra) and Eddie O'Brien (Gene Kelly) harbor a passion for vaudeville. When a local gambler (Edward Arnold) puts a lot of money on the Wolves to lose a big game, he tries to win the bet by offering Eddie the lead role in a newly produced show. Though Eddie is tempted to accept, he risks incurring the wrath of both Dennis and the team's owner (Esther Williams), who just happens to be his girlfriend.

programme.title: Thrill of a Romance
programme.desc: Cynthia Glenn (Esther Williams), a beautiful swimming teacher, marries Robert (Carleton G. Young), a dull but wealthy white-collar worker. The couple travels to the scenic Sierra Nevada Mountains for their honeymoon, but Robert's work gets in the way of romance, and he leaves on a business trip. Before long, Thomas (Van Johnson), a distinguished serviceman on vacation, catches Cynthia's eye -- and the more she gets to know the soldier, the more she wishes she hadn't married Robert.

programme.title: No Leave, No Love
programme.desc: Rushing to the hospital as his wife, Susan (Pat Kirkwood), is about to give birth, Michael Hanlon (Van Johnson) relates to another waiting father how he and Susan met. When Michael returns to New York from the war, he is ordered to appear on a popular armed services radio program hosted by Susan. Unwilling to appear, Michael talks his best friend, Slinky (Keenan Wynn), into impersonating him -- but he soon discovers Susan knows a secret about his personal life and must end the deception.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms
programme.desc: Rivers are the life veins of this planet, offering all those that depend on them respite from both heat and thirst; a look into how for the life they give, they also take away.

programme.title: Wild Kingdoms

programme.title: Earth: The Nature of Our Planet
programme.desc: A miraculous mantle envelops the entire planet - a thin skin of gasses called 'air'. Without it, there would be no life or weather, no habitable conditions, or protection from lethal ultraviolet radiation or meteorites from outer space.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: Caroline aide Max à remplir sa déclaration d'impôts, mais est vite dépassée quand elle découvre à quel point sa colocataire est désordonnée.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: Caroline propose à Max de réduire leur heures de nettoyage pour passer du temps à promouvoir leur boutique de cupcakes. Les filles finissent par se disputer.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls
programme.desc: Entre projets déçus et chagrins d'amour, Max et Caroline n'ont pas le moral. Elles décident d'aller montrer leurs cupcakes à la célèbre Martha Stewart.

programme.title: 2 Broke Girls

programme.title: Mom

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: L'exigeant professeur de droit de Christy la sollicite de manière trop insistante. Bonnie espère pousser Adam à trouver un lieu pour célébrer le mariage...

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy pense que Bonnie se met dans une situation gênante en acceptant d'inviter Tammy, récemment libérée de prison, à venir loger chez elles...

programme.title: Mom

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Christy et Jill se querellent au sujet d'une dette de jeu non réglée. La tension est à son comble. De son côté, Adam s'inquiète à propos du nouveau hobbie de Bonnie...

programme.title: Scrubs

programme.title: Scrubs

programme.title: Scrubs

programme.title: Superstore

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Au grand désarroi d'Amy, Glenn embauche son mari Adam comme intérimaire. Glenn tente de trouver la personne la plus compétente pour tenir le rôle du Père Noël dans l'hypermarché.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: C'est le Black Friday et la situation n'a jamais été aussi chaotique au Cloud 9. La plupart des salariés ont été victimes d'une intoxication alimentaire.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Au début de chaque année, les employés de Cloud Neuf se distribuent au hasard les objets trouvés. Amy tombe sur le jackpot, une énorme liasse de billets.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Jeff annonce aux employés que le vice-président de l'entreprise, Rex, viendra au Cloud 9 pour superviser le relooking de l'ensemble du magasin.

programme.title: Superstore
programme.desc: Jonah et Garrett inventent un jeu pour passer le temps. Dina essaye de remonter le moral d'Amy et la kidnappe le temps d'un déjeuner entre filles.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Les membres du commissariat s'adonnent à leur jeu annuel, le Jimmy Jab. Tous sont déterminés à remporter cette deuxième édition de la compétition...

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: Lorsque de la cocaïne et des armes sont dérobées dans l'armoire où sont enfermées toutes les preuves, l'équipe commence à mener une enquête interne.

programme.title: Italie : des détenus, critiques de cinéma

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A 1971 Chevy Nova with tremendous pedigree arrives at the shop to get classic Kindig-It styling cues; Dave wants to make this car into a hardtop; tucked-in bumpers, front valance and a new engine provide a good test for the crew.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Will makes miracles happen, and Dave decides to make a wholesale change to the car's color; challenges mount at each stage of the build, and the upholstery shop changes up their routine as the client arrives for a reveal years in the making.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: While the shop perfects its process in building the CF1s, word about the car spreads and potential buyers line up; the latest client has a big problem when he can't choose the perfect color combination.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Dave and Kev take the show to the Midwest, as more than 2,500 cars descend on the Summit Motorsports drag strip for a weekend of fun; Kev gets a ride in a lean, mean drag racing machine; Dave steps up his autocross game.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A client enlists Dave on a mission from God to make his dreams of a father/son road trip along Route 66 come true; getting the client's mechanically unsound reproduction of the Bluesmobile ready for the road will test the crew's mettle.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Kevin Schiele breathes new life into a semi-hauler by giving it a visual and functional upgrade that impeccably reflects his expertise in trucks.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Training the next-generation car builders is near and dear to Dave's heart, and after years of planning, he's finally realized his passion project, the Kindig Academy.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A 1969 Camaro comes in; when Dave and team get a closer look, they determine with the owner that it requires a full rebuild; since the team will be starting from scratch, the client decides to go all-out on the chassis, engine and details.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: With the Camaro's design firmed up, the build continues, but hits a roadblock when it comes to getting the engine dialed in just right; Dave has second thoughts about the color combination.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A simple engine repair slowly turns into a patented Kindig slippery slope, as a show-ready 1935 Roadster V8 requires a full rebuild.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The shop hits the road to check out the competition; Will and Dave's cousin Brad comes along for the ride to share their view on the cars they come across; they team up to challenge Dave in an autocross.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The 1955 Nomad is an iconic car, but the original power isn't enough for the current owner, who wants the guys to put a blower on to boost the power; a new project for a secret client arrives in pretty rough shape, but emerges ready to rumble.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: A new client, Rick Mezich from "Deadliest Catch," tests Dave's design prowess on his CF1, while the upholstery shop shows off some of the new processes it has developed to streamline the builds.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Off-road vehicles are few and far between at the shop, but when they do arrive, Dave and the guys love to go all out; this particular Hummer gets a huge conversion from two-wheel drive to four-wheel, a new LS engine, interior and a fresh paint job.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: The shop has a busy week prepping for the 2022 SEMA show in Las Vegas, Nevada; once in Vegas, Dave and Kev attend the first-ever concours d'elegance at the famous Wynn hotel and golf course, where their knowledge of cars will be pushed to its limits.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: As the workshop buzzes with activities, the latest CF1 becomes a new challenge for the team, as Dave makes alterations to the original.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides
programme.desc: Scottsdale is about to witness one of the fiercest competitions at the last car show of the year; Dave gets all the help he needs with his toolbox.

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides

programme.title: Bitchin' Rides

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Owen hat die Kollegen für ein Baseballturnier angemeldet. Aber abseits des OPs machen die Ärzte keine gute Figur. Statt sich aufs Spiel zu konzentrieren, gibt’s Streit. Dafür erhält Derek (Patrick Dempsey) die Nachricht, dass er und Meredith Zola vielleicht zurückbekommen….

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Als der Empfänger einer Herztransplantation vor dem Eingriff verstirbt, soll Christina „Das Herz im Kasten“ bewachen. Derweil bekommt es Neurochirurg Derek mit einer eigenwilligen Patientin zu tun: Justine (Alfre Woodard) will sich erst am Gehirn operieren lassen, wenn sie ihr neues Buch fertiggeschrieben hat.

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Lorelai organisiert für Rorys beste Freundin eine Babyparty, doch muss zuerst die Wogen zwischen Lane und ihrer Mutter glätten. Die konservativen Erziehungsansätze ihrer Mutter passen Lane gar nicht.\n\nAls Rory von einem Vorstellungsgespräch aus New York zurückkehrt, gesteht Logan ihr wie schlecht es bei seiner Arbeit läuft. Er hat einen Fehler begangen und zieht mit seinen Jungs nach Las Vegas,

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Lorelai (Lauren Graham) möchte unbedingt, dass Rory (Alexis Bledel) mit zu Mias Hochzeit nach North Carolina kommt, doch Rory hat das Gefühl, Logan (Matt Czuchry) nicht alleinlassen zu können. Der ist nach dem Firmen-Fiasko psychisch total am Ende.

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Lorelai (Lauren Graham) ist stinksauer, als sie erfährt,dass es zum jährlichen Frühlingsfest keine Fress- und Spielbuden geben wird, sondern ein riesiges Labyrinth aus Strohballen. Tochter Rory steht vor einer schweren Entscheidung über ihre berufliche Zukunft.

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Nach einer Aussprache zwischen Lorelai (Lauren Graham) und Luke (Scott Patterson) braucht es erst eines erneuten Streits beim Kauf eines Autos, damit das Eis zwischen ihnen wirklich bricht. Derweil bekommt Rory endlich Antwort auf ihre Bewerbung für ein Stipendium.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: In mehreren Teams bereiten sich die Ärzte auf die aufwendige Trennung von siamesischen Zwillingen vor. Dabei nervt die nervöse Arizona ihre Kollegen mit unerwünschten Ratschlägen. \r\nTeddy gibt insgeheim Christina die Schuld an Henrys Tod und fragt sie immer wieder über den Eingriff aus.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Der kleine Wes hat einen Hirntumor: inoperabel! Derek und Lexie übernehmen den aussichtslosen Fall trotzdem. Inzwischen feiert Dr. Webber (James Pickens Jr.) seine zehntausendste Operation: Patientin Karen (Nia Vardalos, „My Big Fat Greek Wedding“) soll ein Teil der Leber ihrer zänkischen Schwester Marcy (Peri Gilpin, „Frasier“) transplantiert werden.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Auf die Bewohner der Wisteria Lane lauern an Halloween mehrere „Schreckgespenster“. Renée (Vanessa Williams) ist empört, dass Nachbar Lee (Kevin Rahm) im gleichen Fummel zu ihrer Party erscheint. Und die schwer verliebte Bree lernt eine neue, unangenehme Seite an Keith kennen.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Und die hatte sie gerade noch in pikanter Angelegenheit um Rat gefragt: Wie kann sie die Wechseljahre vor ihrem Toyboy verbergen? Entsprechend verkrampft gestaltet sich das als Kennenlern-Dinner gedachte Abendessen mit Keith’ (Brian Austin Green) Eltern. Karrierefrau Lynette bietet Susan indes einen Nanny-Job an. Entwürdigend, aber gut bezahlt.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Bree lädt Keith’ Eltern zu Thanksgiving ein. Deren „Dankbarkeit“ hält sich aber in Grenzen. Auch das Festmahl der Solis’ läuft nicht nach Plan. Weil Gaby (Eva Longoria Parker) das Dessert vergessen hat, lässt sie sich von ihrem Gast zum Bäcker kutschieren. Kurz darauf klicken die Handschellen.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Zum Entsetzen seiner Nachbarn plant der Psychopath, in der beschaulichen Wohnstraße eine Resozialisierungsanstalt für Verbrecher einzurichten… Keith (Brian Austin Green) tickt romantischer. Er möchte Bree (Marcia Cross) bei einem Candle-Light-Dinner einen Heiratsantrag machen. Doch die schleppt seinen angeblich depressiven Vater mit zum Essen.

programme.title: Fixer Upper: Behind the Design
programme.desc:
Infos zur Reihe:

Im Spin-Off zur Home-Makeover-Serie rückt der kreative Schöpfungsprozess von Joanna Gaines in den Mittelpunkt: „Fixer Upper: Behind the Design“ gibt exklusive und detaillierte Einblicke in die Design-Entscheidungen hinter den spektakulären Transformationen. 

Das Begleitformat enthüllt, wie aus vagen Ideen maßgeschneiderte Wohnkonzepte entstehen, zeigt die kunstvolle Abstimmu

programme.title: Gilmore Girls
programme.desc: Weil Rory (Alexis Bledel) ihr Examen bestanden hat, organisieren Emily und Richard eine Fete für sie. Logan (Matt Czuchry) nutzt die Gunst der Stunde und macht Rory vor aller Augen einen Heiratsantrag.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Titelheldin Meredith Grey (Ellen Pompeo) stellt sich die Frage: „Was wäre, wenn…“ ihre Mutter Ellis niemals Alzheimer bekommen hätte? Die Folge entwirft eine alternative Serienwelt, in der Meredith niemals eine Affäre mit McDreamy hatte und sich die übrigen Charaktere in zum Teil ungewohnten Rollen wiederfinden.

programme.title: Grey's Anatomy – Die jungen Ärzte
programme.desc: Am Valentinstag knistert es: Callie (Sara Ramirez) überrumpelt Arizona (Jessica Capshaw) mit einem romantischen Abend, Derek und Meredith haben mal wieder Zeit für sich, und Ben hat eine Überraschung für Bailey. Diese Gefühlsduseleien machen Lexie klar, dass sie Mark ihre Gefühle zeigen muss.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Pauls Resozialisierungsprojekt für Exknackis steht kurz vor der Umsetzung: Trickreich hat er sich das letzte fehlende Haus in der feinen Wisteria Lane unter den Nagel gerissen. Für Mrs. McCluskey (Kathryn Joosten), Roy (Orson Bean), Porter (Charlie Carver) und andere Anwohner höchste Zeit zu protestieren. Dabei kommt es zur Katastrophe.

programme.title: Desperate Housewives
programme.desc: Nach dem Schuss auf Paul Young sucht die Polizei den „Attentäter“ – und muss feststellen, dass das Opfer offenbar nur Feinde hat. \r\nSusan (Teri Hatcher) landet nach der Massenpanik im Krankenhaus.
